title: Canada and Antigua and Barbuda ministers meet in Toronto
excerpt: Minister of Foreign Affairs Anita Anand and Minister Chet Greene discussed trade, food security, and the upcoming Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting.
bodyHtml:
The Government of Canada announced on September 30, 2026, that Minister of Foreign Affairs Anita Anand met with Chet Greene, Antigua and Barbuda’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Barbuda Affairs. The meeting occurred on the margins of the Pathways to Peace: Second International Conference on Returning Ukrainian Children, Detained Civilians, and Prisoners of War, held in Toronto on September 28 and 29, 2026.

The ministers discussed preparations for the 2026 Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting, which is scheduled to take place in St. John’s, Antigua and Barbuda, from November 1 to 4. Minister Anand highlighted Canada’s support for Antigua and Barbuda’s hosting role and leadership efforts, including capacity-building assistance.

During the meeting, the ministers exchanged views on opportunities to deepen trade and investment ties between the two countries. Minister Anand also underscored Canada’s interest in supporting Antigua and Barbuda’s agricultural sector and food security goals through Canadian agri-tech solutions, technical expertise and reliable suppliers of high-quality food products.
